message.content: {"action": "commit", "move": "e1f1", "objective": "Active rook on f1, avoiding the verified -328 collapse of c3e2; keep rook flexible on the f-file.", "rationale": "c3e2 was verified at depth 4 but its exact score is -328, far worse than e1f1's -25 at depth 3; the shared-depth comparison at depth 3 confirms c3e2 is much worse. e1f1 is commit-ready, passed immediate-mate and checking-chain safety probes, and keeps the rook active without losing material. c3e2 allows Rxe2 netting a knight. Deeper threats remain possible given the depth gap, so this is a pragmatic choice."}
